"5196a682-3b3b-548b-8bcb-d71c48d9fec1" :question/problem "Use the substitution $u=2^{x} + 2$. Which integral is obtained?

$$
\int 3 \cdot 2^{x} \left(2^{x} + 2\right)^{3}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "5196a682-3b3b-548b-8bcb-d71c48d9fec1" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2^{x} + 2$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2^{x} \ln{\left(2 \right)})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work where $2^{x} + 2>0$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 3 \cdot 2^{x} \left(2^{x} + 2\right)^{3}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{\ln{\left(2 \right)}}\left(\int u^{3}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\frac{3}{\ln{\left(2 \right)}}\left(\int u^{3}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "5196a682-3b3b-548b-8bcb-d71c48d9fec1" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "5196a682-3b3b-548b-8bcb-d71c48d9fec1" :question/answer-fields "37076561-9cc7-54e0-b6a6-f12582ef2576" :question/problem "Use the substitution $u=e^{x} + 3$. Which integral is obtained?

$$
\int 3 \left(e^{x} + 3\right)^{2} e^{x}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "37076561-9cc7-54e0-b6a6-f12582ef2576" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=e^{x} + 3$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(e^{x})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work where $e^{x} + 3>0$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 3 \left(e^{x} + 3\right)^{2} e^{x}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=3\left(\int u^{2}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
3\left(\int u^{2}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "37076561-9cc7-54e0-b6a6-f12582ef2576" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "37076561-9cc7-54e0-b6a6-f12582ef2576" :question/answer-fields "3607a00c-ed00-5182-88fc-30842ad51810" :question/problem "Use the substitution $u=e^{2 x} + 2$. $$
\int 2 \left(e^{2 x} + 2\right)^{2} e^{2 x}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "3607a00c-ed00-5182-88fc-30842ad51810" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=e^{2 x} + 2$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2 e^{2 x})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

$$"] [:db/add "3607a00c-ed00-5182-88fc-30842ad51810" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "3607a00c-ed00-5182-88fc-30842ad51810" :question/answer-fields "a26b5c34-17e1-5280-8d13-b4e435154956"] [:db/ensure "3607a00c-ed00-5182-88fc-30842ad51810" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186184351 :knowledge-point/questions "3607a00c-ed00-5182-88fc-30842ad51810"] [:db/add "ac0a3a05-fdcb-5ea7-8f78-c6250c9aa1d0" :answer/id #uuid "ac0a3a05-fdcb-5ea7-8f78-c6250c9aa1d0"] [:db/add "ac0a3a05-fdcb-5ea7-8f78-c6250c9aa1d0" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "ac0a3a05-fdcb-5ea7-8f78-c6250c9aa1d0" :answer/value "\frac{4}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\left(\frac{2 \left(3^{x} + 4\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}{3}\right)"] [:db/ensure "ac0a3a05-fdcb-5ea7-8f78-c6250c9aa1d0" :answer/validate] [:db/add "a79080ff-3a68-56f4-bd9c-22a0870f1b37" :answer-field/id #uuid "a79080ff-3a68-56f4-bd9c-22a0870f1b37"] [:db/add "a79080ff-3a68-56f4-bd9c-22a0870f1b37" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "a79080ff-3a68-56f4-bd9c-22a0870f1b37" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "a79080ff-3a68-56f4-bd9c-22a0870f1b37" :answer-field/choices "ac0a3a05-fdcb-5ea7-8f78-c6250c9aa1d0"] [:db/add "a79080ff-3a68-56f4-bd9c-22a0870f1b37" :answer-field/correct "ac0a3a05-fdcb-5ea7-8f78-c6250c9aa1d0"] [:db/ensure "a79080ff-3a68-56f4-bd9c-22a0870f1b37" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "0156d36e-072e-5215-9c38-b10ce4b47e6d" :question/id #uuid "0156d36e-072e-5215-9c38-b10ce4b47e6d"] [:db/add "0156d36e-072e-5215-9c38-b10ce4b47e6d" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int 4 \cdot 3^{x} \sqrt{3^{x} + 4}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \sqrt{u}\,\mathrm{d}u=\frac{2 u^{\frac{3}{2}}}{3}+C$.

Work where $3^{x} + 4>0$.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "0156d36e-072e-5215-9c38-b10ce4b47e6d" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3^{x} + 4$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(3^{x} \ln{\left(3 \right)})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work where $3^{x} + 4>0$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 4 \cdot 3^{x} \sqrt{3^{x} + 4}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{4}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\left(\int \sqrt{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\frac{4}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\left(\int \sqrt{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{4}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\left(\frac{2 u^{\frac{3}{2}}}{3}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{4}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\left(\frac{2 \left(3^{x} + 4\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}{3}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "0156d36e-072e-5215-9c38-b10ce4b47e6d" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "0156d36e-072e-5215-9c38-b10ce4b47e6d" :question/answer-fields "a79080ff-3a68-56f4-bd9c-22a0870f1b37"] [:db/ensure "0156d36e-072e-5215-9c38-b10ce4b47e6d" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186184351 :knowledge-point/questions "0156d36e-072e-5215-9c38-b10ce4b47e6d"] [:db/add "ec0420e0-bc5c-5ba5-bc50-0c2ecb853f02" :answer/id #uuid "ec0420e0-bc5c-5ba5-bc50-0c2ecb853f02"] [:db/add "ec0420e0-bc5c-5ba5-bc50-0c2ecb853f02" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "ec0420e0-bc5c-5ba5-bc50-0c2ecb853f02" :answer/value "\frac{2}{\ln{\left(5 \right)}}\left(\ln\left|5^{x} + 2\right|\right)"] [:db/ensure "ec0420e0-bc5c-5ba5-bc50-0c2ecb853f02" :answer/validate] [:db/add "cd09eb4b-c664-50f9-8113-b56c9880d85e" :answer-field/id #uuid "cd09eb4b-c664-50f9-8113-b56c9880d85e"] [:db/add "cd09eb4b-c664-50f9-8113-b56c9880d85e" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "cd09eb4b-c664-50f9-8113-b56c9880d85e" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "cd09eb4b-c664-50f9-8113-b56c9880d85e" :answer-field/choices "ec0420e0-bc5c-5ba5-bc50-0c2ecb853f02"] [:db/add "cd09eb4b-c664-50f9-8113-b56c9880d85e" :answer-field/correct "ec0420e0-bc5c-5ba5-bc50-0c2ecb853f02"] [:db/ensure "cd09eb4b-c664-50f9-8113-b56c9880d85e" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "eaed86d4-f4ba-55c4-8957-65e72c41413d" :question/id #uuid "eaed86d4-f4ba-55c4-8957-65e72c41413d"] [:db/add "eaed86d4-f4ba-55c4-8957-65e72c41413d" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{2 \cdot 5^{x}}{5^{x} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u=\ln\left|u\right|+C$.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "eaed86d4-f4ba-55c4-8957-65e72c41413d" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5^{x} + 2$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5^{x} \ln{\left(5 \right)})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Use a connected real interval on which the integrand is defined.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2 \cdot 5^{x}}{5^{x} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{2}{\ln{\left(5 \right)}}\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\frac{2}{\ln{\left(5 \right)}}\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{2}{\ln{\left(5 \right)}}\left(\ln\left|u\right|\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{2}{\ln{\left(5 \right)}}\left(\ln\left|5^{x} + 2\right|\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "eaed86d4-f4ba-55c4-8957-65e72c41413d" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "eaed86d4-f4ba-55c4-8957-65e72c41413d" :question/answer-fields "cd09eb4b-c664-50f9-8113-b56c9880d85e"] [:db/ensure "eaed86d4-f4ba-55c4-8957-65e72c41413d" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186184351 :knowledge-point/questions "eaed86d4-f4ba-55c4-8957-65e72c41413d"] [:db/add "d8ce16e4-e6e9-5770-bd52-c528f41d4c34" :answer/id #uuid "d8ce16e4-e6e9-5770-bd52-c528f41d4c34"] [:db/add "d8ce16e4-e6e9-5770-bd52-c528f41d4c34" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "d8ce16e4-e6e9-5770-bd52-c528f41d4c34" :answer/value "4\left(\ln\left|e^{x} + 1\right|\right)"] [:db/ensure "d8ce16e4-e6e9-5770-bd52-c528f41d4c34" :answer/validate] [:db/add "e044980f-df8c-5ebc-9aab-7e314954a789" :answer-field/id #uuid "e044980f-df8c-5ebc-9aab-7e314954a789"] [:db/add "e044980f-df8c-5ebc-9aab-7e314954a789" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "e044980f-df8c-5ebc-9aab-7e314954a789" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "e044980f-df8c-5ebc-9aab-7e314954a789" :answer-field/choices "d8ce16e4-e6e9-5770-bd52-c528f41d4c34"] [:db/add "e044980f-df8c-5ebc-9aab-7e314954a789" :answer-field/correct "d8ce16e4-e6e9-5770-bd52-c528f41d4c34"] [:db/ensure "e044980f-df8c-5ebc-9aab-7e314954a789" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "234b841b-ddf2-5537-9f3b-c343ab766392" :question/id #uuid "234b841b-ddf2-5537-9f3b-c343ab766392"] [:db/add "234b841b-ddf2-5537-9f3b-c343ab766392" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{3 e^{x}}{\sqrt{e^{x} + 3}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u}}\,\mathrm{d}u=2 \sqrt{u}+C$.

Work where $e^{x} + 3>0$.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "79fd7a1c-f80b-5f30-b249-83e9987f33c8" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=e^{x} + 3$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(e^{x})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work where $e^{x} + 3>0$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3 e^{x}}{\sqrt{e^{x} + 3}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=3\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
3\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=3\left(2 \sqrt{u}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "ad79e0bf-30a8-5a5e-8565-5721f911bb72" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=- 2 x + e^{2 x} + 4$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2 e^{2 x} - 2)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

$$
\int 2 \cdot 3^{x} \left(3^{x} + 2\right)^{2}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "d122d325-dd4e-5e3c-9bf4-42390c0e7f21" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3^{x} + 2$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(3^{x} \ln{\left(3 \right)})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 2 \cdot 3^{x} \left(3^{x} + 2\right)^{2}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{2}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\left(\int u^{2}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\frac{2}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\left(\int u^{2}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "d122d325-dd4e-5e3c-9bf4-42390c0e7f21" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "d122d325-dd4e-5e3c-9bf4-42390c0e7f21" :question/answer-fields $$

$$

$$
\int 4 \cdot 3^{x} \sqrt{3^{x} + 4}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \sqrt{u}\,\mathrm{d}u=\frac{2 u^{\frac{3}{2}}}{3}+C$.

Work where $3^{x} + 4>0$.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "0156d36e-072e-5215-9c38-b10ce4b47e6d" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3^{x} + 4$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(3^{x} \ln{\left(3 \right)})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work where $3^{x} + 4>0$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 4 \cdot 3^{x} \sqrt{3^{x} + 4}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{4}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\left(\int \sqrt{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\frac{4}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\left(\int \sqrt{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{4}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\left(\frac{2 u^{\frac{3}{2}}}{3}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{4}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\left(\frac{2 \left(3^{x} + 4\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}{3}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "0156d36e-072e-5215-9c38-b10ce4b47e6d" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "0156d36e-072e-5215-9c38-b10ce4b47e6d" :question/answer-fields "a79080ff-3a68-56f4-bd9c-22a0870f1b37"] [:db/ensure "0156d36e-072e-5215-9c38-b10ce4b47e6d" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186184351 :knowledge-point/questions "0156d36e-072e-5215-9c38-b10ce4b47e6d"] [:db/add "ec0420e0-bc5c-5ba5-bc50-0c2ecb853f02" :answer/id #uuid "ec0420e0-bc5c-5ba5-bc50-0c2ecb853f02"] [:db/add "ec0420e0-bc5c-5ba5-bc50-0c2ecb853f02" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "ec0420e0-bc5c-5ba5-bc50-0c2ecb853f02" :answer/value "\frac{2}{\ln{\left(5 \right)}}\left(\ln\left|5^{x} + 2\right|\right)"] [:db/ensure "ec0420e0-bc5c-5ba5-bc50-0c2ecb853f02" :answer/validate] [:db/add "cd09eb4b-c664-50f9-8113-b56c9880d85e" :answer-field/id #uuid "cd09eb4b-c664-50f9-8113-b56c9880d85e"] [:db/add "cd09eb4b-c664-50f9-8113-b56c9880d85e" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "cd09eb4b-c664-50f9-8113-b56c9880d85e" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "cd09eb4b-c664-50f9-8113-b56c9880d85e" :answer-field/choices "ec0420e0-bc5c-5ba5-bc50-0c2ecb853f02"] [:db/add "cd09eb4b-c664-50f9-8113-b56c9880d85e" :answer-field/correct "ec0420e0-bc5c-5ba5-bc50-0c2ecb853f02"] [:db/ensure "cd09eb4b-c664-50f9-8113-b56c9880d85e" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "eaed86d4-f4ba-55c4-8957-65e72c41413d" :question/id #uuid "eaed86d4-f4ba-55c4-8957-65e72c41413d"] [:db/add "eaed86d4-f4ba-55c4-8957-65e72c41413d" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{2 \cdot 5^{x}}{5^{x} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u=\ln\left|u\right|+C$.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "eaed86d4-f4ba-55c4-8957-65e72c41413d" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5^{x} + 2$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5^{x} \ln{\left(5 \right)})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Use a connected real interval on which the integrand is defined.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2 \cdot 5^{x}}{5^{x} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{2}{\ln{\left(5 \right)}}\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\frac{2}{\ln{\left(5 \right)}}\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{2}{\ln{\left(5 \right)}}\left(\ln\left|u\right|\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{2}{\ln{\left(5 \right)}}\left(\ln\left|5^{x} + 2\right|\right)+C.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "bc08d550-1e24-59f1-bab8-fa99a8cbf667" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x + e^{2 x} + 1$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2 e^{2 x} + 2)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Use a connected real interval on which the integrand is defined.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3 e^{2 x} + 3}{2 x + e^{2 x} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{3}{2}\left(\ln\left|u\right|\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

{{answer}} $+C$"] ["0156d36e-072e-5215-9c38-b10ce4b47e6d" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3^{x} + 4$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(3^{x} \ln{\left(3 \right)})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

$$

$$

{{answer}} $+C$"] ["eaed86d4-f4ba-55c4-8957-65e72c41413d" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5^{x} + 2$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5^{x} \ln{\left(5 \right)})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Use a connected real interval on which the integrand is defined.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2 \cdot 5^{x}}{5^{x} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{2}{\ln{\left(5 \right)}}\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$
